data.slice_rule: 12 dev worlds x (object 0/1 x place 0/1) = 48 examples

conditions.ledger: gold prefix fed (teacher forcing), model's own alpha/beta/gamma; route_hit = alpha's hard route owns this byte; beta_hit = argmax of that record's beta posterior equals the byte offset (the copy-start claim); carry_hit = read.m_peak (inside-run continuation only, never a start claim); start_hit = route_hit and beta_hit; conditional_byte = tail bytes only among start-hit examples; gamma = generation weight, 1 - gamma = copy weight; no credit inference (M3)
conditions.sweep: frozen routing_step (arm-locked alpha/beta); probability mix rebuilt with gamma = model value or forced to 0.6/0.5/0.4/0.3/0.2/0.0; gamma = generation weight, 1 - gamma = copy weight
conditions.c_gamma0: gold record + every content position pinned + gamma = 0: gold-start ceiling, not the model's own route
conditions.positions: per content byte hit rate under b_pure and c_gamma0 (both gold-start)
conditions.utf8: free decode under gamma = 1 (pure generate) vs gamma = 0 (copy-dominant; the null-route generated mass of q_null remains) vs c_gamma0 (correct-routing copy control)
conditions.start_origin: ledger.start_hit / sweep are the model's own beta route; b_pure and c_gamma0 are gold-start controls and are reported separately, never merged
